### Figure X3 B: Number of cell types by annotation method

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=5}
annotation_cell_type_count <- function(bundle, method, dataset) {
  if (is.null(bundle) || !"feat_mat" %in% names(bundle)) {
    stop(
      "Missing feature matrix for annotation method '", method,
      "' in dataset '", dataset, "'."
    )
  }

  if (identical(method, "ECODA_deconv")) {
    # ECODA_deconv has inferred EPIC components but no counts field.
    cell_type_names <- colnames(bundle$feat_mat)
    count_source <- "feat_mat component columns"
  } else {
    if (!"counts" %in% names(bundle) || is.null(bundle$counts)) {
      stop(
        "Missing top-level counts field for annotation method '", method,
        "' in dataset '", dataset, "'."
      )
    }
    cell_type_names <- colnames(bundle$counts)
    count_source <- "counts columns"
  }

  if (is.null(cell_type_names) || length(cell_type_names) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "Empty ", count_source, " for annotation method '", method,
      "' in dataset '", dataset, "'."
    )
  }

  cell_type_names <- trimws(as.character(cell_type_names))
  invalid <- is.na(cell_type_names) |
    !nzchar(cell_type_names) |
    cell_type_names %in% c("NA", "nan", "None", "Unknown")
  valid_names <- cell_type_names[!invalid]
  unique_names <- unique(valid_names)
  if (length(valid_names) == 0L || length(unique_names) != length(valid_names)) {
    stop(
      "Invalid or duplicated cell-type identities in ", count_source,
      " for annotation method '", method, "' in dataset '", dataset, "'."
    )
  }
  length(unique_names)
}

df_celltype_counts <- imap_dfr(bmark_result_list, function(ds_results, dataset_name) {
  map_dfr(filter_methods, function(method_name) {
    bundle <- ds_results[[method_name]]
    tibble(
      dataset = dataset_name,
      method = method_name,
      n_cell_types = annotation_cell_type_count(
        bundle,
        method = method_name,
        dataset = dataset_name
      )
    )
  })
})

if (!setequal(unique(df_celltype_counts$method), filter_methods)) {
  stop("Figure X3 B annotation method selection is incomplete.")
}

df_celltype_counts <- df_celltype_counts %>%
  apply_method_labels(method_label_map_annotation) %>%
  mutate(method = factor(method, levels = annotation_method_order))

if (anyNA(df_celltype_counts$method)) {
  stop("Figure X3 B method labels do not match Figure 3 A's method order.")
}

p_celltypes <- ggplot(
  df_celltype_counts,
  aes(x = method, y = n_cell_types)
) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_se", geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", fill = "white", color = "black") +
  geom_point(aes(shape = dataset, color = dataset), size = pointsize) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = 1:length(unique(df_celltype_counts$dataset))) +
  geom_line(
    aes(group = dataset, linetype = dataset, color = dataset),
    alpha = 1
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = c(2, 3, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000),
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(2, NA_real_), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Number of cell types (log10 scale)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 65, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))
print(p_celltypes)
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
    cluster_score = FALSE,mod_score = FALSE, anosim_score = FALSE,
    coord_equal = TRUE, pointsize = 2,
    n_ct_show = 5, invisible = "quali", repel = TRUE,
    title = methods[[m]]
  )
}

wrap_plots(plot_list) +
  plot_layout(nrow = 2, guides = "collect")

ggsave(file.path(path_plots, "Figure_3_B_annotationmethods_pca_adams.pdf"),
```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=12}
requested_datas <- c("Bassez", "Lee", "Stephenson")
datas <- intersect(requested_datas, names(result_list[["bmark"]]))
missing_datas <- setdiff(requested_datas, datas)
if (length(missing_datas) > 0) {
  message(
    "Supp fig 19: skipping datasets without benchmark-analysis bundles: ",
    paste(missing_datas, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

  stop("Supp fig 19 has no datasets with benchmark-analysis bundles.")
}

methods <- list(
  "ECODA_authors_HR" = "ECODA_authors_HR",
  # "ECODA_authors_LR" = "ECODA_authors_LR",
  "ECODA_HiTME_HR_layer2" = "ECODA_HiTME",
  "ECODA_scATOMIC_HR" = "ECODA_scATOMIC",
  # "ECODA_deconv" = "ECODA_deconv",
  "ECODA_seuratres_2" = "ECODA_Leiden_res_2"
  # "ECODA_seuratres_0.1" = "ECODA_Leiden_res_0.1"
)

plot_list <- list()

for (ds in datas) {
  pl <- list()
  for (m in names(methods)) {
    if (ds == "Lee" & m == "ECODA_authors_HR") next
    
    dist_mat <- result_list[["bmark"]][[ds]][[m]]$dist_mat
    labels <- result_list[["bmark"]][[ds]][[m]][["labels"]]
    
    if (ds == "Bassez") {
      labels <- as.character(labels)

      labels[labels == "NE"] <- "Non-responders"
      labels <- factor(labels, levels = c("Responders", "Non-responders"))
    }

}
```

### Supp fig 2: Method parameter screening

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=14}
filter_methods <- c(
  "ECODA_authors_HR",
  "ECODA_authors_LR",
  "ECODA_deconv",
  "ECODA_HiTME_HR_layer2",
  "ECODA_HiTME_HR_layer3",
  "ECODA_scATOMIC_HR",
  "ECODA_seuratres_0.4",
  "ECODA_seuratres_2",
  "ECODA_seuratres_5",
  "ECODA_seuratres_20"
)

# default_methods / default_methods_regex are defined once in the setup chunk
# (highlighting of default methods in this screening figure).

supp_fig_2_scores <- base_metrics
supp_fig_2_score_labels <- c(
  "anosim_score" = "ANOSIM",
  "mod_knn3_score" = "Modularity",
  "cluster_score" = "ARI",
  "sil_score" = "Silhouette",
  "lisi_score" = "LISI"
)

supp_fig_2_plot <- df_benchmark %>%
  filter(score %in% supp_fig_2_scores) %>%
  filter(!grepl("HiTME|scATOMIC|seuratres|ECODA_authors_HR_NULL|ECODA_authors_LR|ECODA_deconv|Freq_highres|varexp|varcts|Avg_PCA|combo|CT_LR|schvg", method)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    if_else(grepl("scPoli", method), grepl("highres|lowres", method), TRUE)
  ) %>%
  # filter(method %in% filter_methods) %>%
  # mutate(method = recode(method,
  #                        "MOFA_2_factors" = "MOFA",
  #                        "scITD_2_factors" = "scITD",
  #                        "ECODA_highres" = "ECODA")) %>%
  
  # CREATE THE FACETING GROUP COLUMN
  mutate(
    score = factor(score, levels = supp_fig_2_scores),
    method_plot = case_when(
      grepl("^ECODA_", method) ~ "ECODA",
      grepl("^(MOFA_|MOFAcellulaR_)", method) ~ "MOFA",
      grepl("^MrVI_", method) ~ "MrVI",
      grepl("^scITD_", method) ~ "scITD",
      grepl("^GloScope_", method) ~ "GloScope",
      grepl("^GloProp", method) ~ "GloScope",
      grepl("^PILOT_", method) ~ "PILOT",
      grepl("^PILOT-GM-VAE_", method) ~ "PILOT-GM-VAE",
      grepl("^QOT_", method) ~ "QOT",
      grepl("^scPoli_", method) ~ "scPoli",
      grepl("^Pseudobulk_", method) ~ "Pseudobulk",
      TRUE ~ method # Keep any other simple names as they are
    ),
    
    method_plot = factor(method_plot, 
                         levels = c("ECODA", "Pseudobulk", "MrVI", "GloScope", "GloProp",
                                    "scPoli", "MOFA", "PILOT", "scITD", "QOT",
                                    "PILOT-GM-VAE"))
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(method = method %>%
           # Swap highres/lowres
           stringr::str_replace_all(c("highres"  = "HR", 
                                      "lowres"   = "LR",
                                      "0_dims"    = "0_embdims")) %>%
           stringr::str_replace("Pseudobulk_(\\d+)_PCA_dims", "Pseudobulk_hvg2000_pcadims\\1") %>%
           stringr::str_replace("(\\d+)_PCA_dims", "pcadims\\1") %>%
           stringr::str_replace("PILOT_hvg(\\d+)", "PILOT_hvg\\1_HR") %>%
           stringr::str_replace("QOT_hvg(\\d+)", "QOT_hvg\\1_HR") %>%
           stringr::str_replace("PILOT-GM-VAE_hvg(\\d+)", "PILOT-GM-VAE_hvg\\1_HR")
  ) %>%
  
  group_by(method) %>%
  mutate(mean_value = mean(value[score == "anosim_score"])) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(method, mean_value, .desc = TRUE),
             y = value, 
             fill = ifelse(grepl(default_methods_regex, method), "cornflowerblue", "gray70"))) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_se", geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar") +
  labs(x = "", y = "") +
  theme_classic2(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_markdown(angle = 90, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
  panel.grid.major.y = element_line(size = 0.25, linetype = 'solid',
                                colour = "lightgrey"), 
  panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(size = 0.25, linetype = 'solid',
                                colour = "lightgrey")) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  # Highlight default methods
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) highlight(
    x,
    default_methods_regex,
    "black")
  ) +
  # ylim(c(-0.4, 1)) +
  facet_grid(scales = "free",
             space='free',
             rows = vars(score),
             cols = vars(method_plot), # Use the new grouping column for column faceting
             labeller = labeller(
               score = as_labeller(supp_fig_2_score_labels),
               method_plot = function(labels) sub("^PILOT-GM-VAE$", "PILOT-G-V", labels)
             ))


ggsave(file.path(path_plots, "Supp_fig_2_methodparameter_screening.pdf"),
       plot = supp_fig_2_plot,
       width = 14,
       height = 8)
```

## Figure 4 AB: Plot feature selection

Surprisingly, even at the lowest number highly variable cell types (i.e. variance explained of 10% -\> \>=2 cell types) the average biological separation is quite very high. Different daatasets can do with a different number of highly variable cell types (separation plateaus out at different levels of variance explained % and number of cell types retained).

```{r}
df_benchmark_sub <- df_benchmark %>%
  # filter(score == "anosim_score") %>%
  filter(score %in% benchmark_metrics) %>%
  filter(grepl("ECODA_authors_HR", method) & !grepl("HiTME|scATOMIC|PCA|NULL|most|least", method)) %>%
  filter(!grepl("cmv|sex", dataset)) %>%
  filter(!method == "ECODA_authors_HR_top_varexp0") %>%
  mutate(method = recode(method,
                         "ECODA_authors_HR" = "100",
                         "ECODA_authors_HR_top_varexp0" = "2most_varcts")) %>%
  mutate(method = gsub("ECODA_authors_HR", "", method)) %>%
  mutate(method = if_else(
    grepl("^_top_varexp0\\.\\d", method),
    paste0(as.integer(gsub("_top_varexp0\\.", "", method)) * 10),
    method
  )) %>%
  # mutate(method = gsub("top_varexp0", "2most_varcts", method)) %>%
  mutate(method = fct_relevel(method)) %>%
  mutate(method = factor(method, levels = rev(mixedsort(levels(method))))) %>%
  mutate(dataset = recode(dataset,
                          "GongSharma_all_age" = "GongSharma"))

df_benchmark_anosim <- df_benchmark_sub %>% filter(score == "anosim_score")

             "(~", min(perc_tot), "-", max(perc_tot), "% of the total) ",

unique(df_benchmark_sub$method)

  scale_shape_manual(values=1:length(unique((df_benchmark_sub$dataset)))) +
```

# Plot execution times

## Unified execution times (HPC feather + bundle rows)

```{r}
# Single source of execution times, regenerated fresh on EVERY knit (no
# data/exec_times.rds cache: a stale cache would pin old rows, e.g. NA
# mem_GB for R methods computed before the workers logged peak RAM):
# 1. The NAS merged feather (${NAS_TARGET_DIR}/benchmark/embeddings/
#    execution_times.feather): HPC rows (R heavy methods, composition
#    methods, python methods, trans/zeroimp, prepare_pseudobulk_*), schema
#    dataset/method/time_secs/mem_GB (mem_GB = worker peak RSS: python
#    ru_maxrss, R /proc/self/status VmHWM).
# 2. Bundle-derived rows for methods the feather does not cover — union by
#    (dataset, method); mem_GB taken from the bundle when present.
exec_times_feather <- file.path(path_nas_embeddings, "execution_times.feather")
if (!file.exists(exec_times_feather)) {
  stop(
    "Merged execution-times feather not found: ", exec_times_feather,
    "\nRun the benchmark pipelines (they merge + sync execution_times.feather",
    " to the NAS) and make sure the NAS is mounted."
  )
}
feather_exec_times <- arrow::read_feather(exec_times_feather) %>%
  as.data.frame()

bundle_exec_times <- imap_dfr(result_list[["bmark"]], ~ {
  dataset_name <- .y
  imap_dfr(.x, function(bundle, method_name) {
    if ("exec_time" %in% names(bundle)) {
      data.frame(
        dataset = dataset_name,
        method = method_name,
        time_secs = as.numeric(bundle[["exec_time"]], units = "secs"),
        mem_GB = if ("mem_GB" %in% names(bundle)) {
          as.numeric(bundle[["mem_GB"]])
        } else {
          NA_real_
        },
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    } else {
      NULL # no timing (e.g. methods that failed to compute)
    }
  })
})

# Normalize keys so the merge with df_benchmark (paste0(dataset, method)
# join, helpers.R::merge_exec_times) hits:
# - GongSharma: internal key Gongsharma_cmv_young_males is displayed as
#   GongSharma (same rename as bmark_result_list above);
# - PILOT/QOT/PILOT-GM-VAE: the feather rows are <method>_hvg<n>_highres,
#   the bundles <method>_hvg<n>.
normalize_exec_keys <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      dataset = recode(dataset, "Gongsharma_cmv_young_males" = "GongSharma"),
      method = gsub("^(PILOT_hvg[0-9]+)_highres$", "\\1", method),
      method = gsub("^(QOT_hvg[0-9]+)_highres$", "\\1", method),
      method = gsub("^(PILOT-GM-VAE_hvg[0-9]+)_highres$", "\\1", method)
    )
}
feather_exec_times <- normalize_exec_keys(feather_exec_times)
bundle_exec_times <- normalize_exec_keys(bundle_exec_times)

# Feather rows win for the HPC methods; bundle rows fill the methods
# missing from the feather.
exec_times <- bind_rows(
  feather_exec_times,
  bundle_exec_times %>%
    anti_join(feather_exec_times, by = c("dataset", "method"))
)

# n_cells per dataset (from the metadata bundles via the dataset loop;
# display keys).
n_cells_lookup <- unlist(n_cells_by_ds)
exec_times$n_cells <- n_cells_lookup[exec_times$dataset]

# NAS feather covers all benchmark datasets; keep only this run's datasets
# (n_cells_by_ds keys are display keys, matching exec_times$dataset).
exec_times <- exec_times[exec_times$dataset %in% names(n_cells_by_ds), ]
```

## Supp fig 14: Plot

```{r}
filter_methods <- methods_in_scope(c(
  "ECODA_authors_HR",

  # "Pseudobulk_hvg2000",
  "Pseudobulk_hvg2000",
  
  "MOFA_hvg2000_factors15",
  "scITD_hvg2000_factors5",
  "GloScope_hvg2000_pcadims30",
  "GloProp",
  "MrVI_hvg2000",
  "scPoli_hvg2000_dims15_highres",
  "PILOT_hvg2000",
  "QOT_hvg2000",
  "PILOT-GM-VAE_hvg2000"
))

scientific_A_10n <- function(x) {
  s <- scales::scientific_format(digits = 2)(x) 
  s_converted <- gsub("e\\+", " %*% 10^", s) 
  return(parse(text = s_converted)) 
}
# Fit and draw the regression in log10(number of cells) / log10(response)
# coordinates. The raw axes are log-scaled below, so the displayed line is
# straight in the same log-log space used for the model.
fit_log_log_lines <- function(data, y_col) {
  groups <- split(data, data$method)
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(groups, function(df) {
    x <- as.numeric(df$n_cells)
    y <- as.numeric(df[[y_col]])
    keep <- is.finite(x) & x > 0 & is.finite(y) & y > 0
    x <- x[keep]
    y <- y[keep]
    if (length(x) < 2L) return(NULL)
    fit <- stats::lm(log10(y) ~ log10(x))
    x_grid <- 10^seq(
      log10(min(x)),
      log10(max(x)),
      length.out = 100L
    )
    data.frame(
      method = as.character(df$method[[1L]]),
      n_cells = x_grid,
      fitted = 10^stats::predict(
        fit,
        newdata = data.frame(x = x_grid)
      ),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
}
# Place labels in a deterministic right-hand lane. Repulsion in raw
# coordinates is unstable after log transformation; spacing labels in the
# already-log10 y coordinate guarantees no text overlap.
spread_log_label_y <- function(data, min_gap = 0.2, x_offset = 0.18) {
  data <- data[order(data$log_pred_y, decreasing = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
  data$log_label_y <- data$log_pred_y
  if (nrow(data) > 1L) {
    for (i in 2:nrow(data)) {
      data$log_label_y[i] <- min(
        data$log_label_y[i],
        data$log_label_y[i - 1L] - min_gap
      )
    }
  }
  data$log_label_x <- max(data$log_max_x) + x_offset
  data
}
spread_log_label_y_centered <- function(
  data,
  min_gap = 0.15,
  x_offset = 0.18
) {
  data <- data[order(data$log_pred_y, decreasing = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
  n_labels <- nrow(data)
  if (n_labels == 0L) return(data)
  center_y <- mean(range(data$log_pred_y))
  span_y <- min_gap * max(n_labels - 1L, 0L)
  data$log_label_y <- seq(
    center_y + span_y / 2,
    center_y - span_y / 2,
    length.out = n_labels
  )
  data$log_label_x <- max(data$log_max_x) + x_offset
  data
}

# --- 1. Clean Data ---
plot_data <- exec_times %>%
  filter(method %in% filter_methods) %>%
  # filter(!dataset %in% c("GongSharma_all_cmv", "GongSharma_all_sex")) %>%
  mutate(method = recode(method,
                         "ECODA_authors_HR" = "ECODA",
                         "Pseudobulk_hvg2000" = "Pseudobulk",
                         "MOFA_hvg2000_factors15" = "MOFA",
                         "scITD_hvg2000_factors5" = "scITD",
                         "GloScope_hvg2000_pcadims30" = "GloScope",
                         "MrVI_hvg2000" = "MrVI",
                         "scPoli_hvg2000_dims15_highres" = "scPoli",
                         "PILOT_hvg2000" = "PILOT",
                         "QOT_hvg2000" = "QOT",
                         "PILOT-GM-VAE_hvg2000" = "PILOT-GM-VAE"))

regression_lines <- fit_log_log_lines(plot_data, "time_secs")
line_ends <- regression_lines %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    max_x = max(n_cells),
    pred_y = fitted[which.max(n_cells)],
    .groups = "drop"
  )
line_ends_log <- spread_log_label_y(
  line_ends %>%
    mutate(
      log_max_x = log10(max_x),
      log_pred_y = log10(pred_y)
    ),
  min_gap = 0.22
)
line_ends_raw <- line_ends_log %>%
  mutate(
    endpoint_x = 10^log_max_x,
    endpoint_y = 10^log_pred_y,
    label_x = 10^log_label_x,
    label_y = 10^log_label_y
  )
plot_x_breaks <- c(1e5, 3e5, 1e6)
plot_y_breaks <- c(1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000)

# --- NEW STEP: Create Ranked Color Palette ---

# A. Sort methods by predicted time (Fastest/Lowest -> Slowest/Highest)
ranked_methods <- line_ends %>%
  arrange(pred_y) %>%
  pull(method)

# B. Create a gradient function (Green -> Black -> Red)
# I used "forestgreen" and "firebrick" as they are usually more readable than neon green/red
grad_func <- colorRampPalette(c("dodgerblue3", "grey50", "red"))

# C. Generate the exact number of colors needed
method_colors <- grad_func(length(ranked_methods))

# D. Assign the method names to the colors so ggplot maps them correctly
names(method_colors) <- ranked_methods


ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(x = n_cells, y = time_secs, color = method)
) +
  annotation_logticks(sides = "bl", color = "grey80") +
  geom_point(shape = 4, size = 1, stroke = 1.25, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(
    data = regression_lines,
    aes(x = n_cells, y = fitted, color = method),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = line_ends_raw,
    aes(
      x = endpoint_x,
      y = endpoint_y,
      xend = label_x,
      yend = label_y
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "grey50",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = line_ends_raw,
    aes(
      x = label_x,
      y = label_y,
      label = method,
      color = method
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 4,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(x = "Number of cells", y = "Time (s)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = plot_x_breaks,
    labels = function(x) sapply(x, scientific_A_10n),
    limits = c(
      min(plot_data$n_cells),
      max(plot_data$n_cells) * 10^0.65
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = plot_y_breaks,
    labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x))
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave(file.path(path_plots, "Supp_fig_14_benchmark_exec_times.pdf"),
       width = 6.0,
       height = 3.5, limitsize = FALSE)
```

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=12}
  "MrVI_hvg2000",
  "scPoli_hvg2000_dims15_highres",
  "PILOT_hvg2000",
  "GloScope_hvg2000_pcadims30",
  "QOT_hvg2000",
  "PILOT-GM-VAE_hvg2000"
))

df_results_bmark <- merge_exec_times(df_benchmark, exec_times)

clean_data <- df_results_bmark %>%
  filter(score %in% benchmark_metrics, method %in% filter_methods) %>%
  mutate(method = recode(method,
                         "ECODA_authors_HR" = "ECODA",
                         "ECODA_authors_HR_NULL" = "Shuffled_baseline",
                         # "ECODA_HiTME_HR_layer2" = "ECODA_automated",
                         # "ECODA_HiTME_HR_layer3" = "ECODA_automated_(HiTME_layer3)",
                         # "ECODA_seuratres_2" = "ECODA_unsupervised",
                         "ECODA_PB_combo_normquantile_ecodaweight0.5" = "ECODA+Pseudobulk",
                         # "Pseudobulk_10_PCA_dims" = "Pseudobulk_PCA",
                         "Pseudobulk_hvg2000" = "Pseudobulk",
                         # "Pseudobulk_schvg2000" = "Pseudobulk_schvg",
                         # "Freq_highres" = "ECODA_Freq%",
                         "MOFA_hvg2000_factors15" = "MOFA",
                         "scITD_hvg2000_factors5" = "scITD",
                         "MrVI_hvg2000" = "MrVI",
                         "scPoli_hvg2000_dims15_highres" = "scPoli",
                         "scITD_2_factors" = "scITD",
                         "PILOT_hvg2000" = "PILOT",
                         "GloScope_hvg2000_pcadims30" = "GloScope",
                         "QOT_hvg2000" = "QOT",
                         "PILOT-GM-VAE_hvg2000" = "PILOT-GM-VAE")) %>%
  mutate(score = recode(score, !!!score_label_map)) %>%
  mutate(dataset = recode(dataset,
                          "GongSharma_all_age" = "GongSharma_age",
                          "GongSharma_all_cmv" = "GongSharma_cmv",
                          "GongSharma_all_sex" = "GongSharma_sex"))

# --- 1. TRANSFORMATION TO RANKS ---
df_ranked <- clean_data %>%
  group_by(dataset, score) %>%
  mutate(rank = rank(-value, ties.method = "average")) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- 2. AGGREGATE RANK-BASED SCORES ---
df_overall <- df_ranked %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Overall_Rank = mean(rank, na.rm = TRUE))

df_datasets_wide <- df_ranked %>%
  group_by(method, dataset) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(avg_rank = mean(rank, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = method, names_from = dataset, 
              values_from = avg_rank, names_prefix = "Dataset__")

target_metric_order <- c("ANOSIM", "Modularity", "ARI")

df_metrics_wide <- df_ranked %>%
  mutate(score = factor(score, levels = target_metric_order)) %>%
  group_by(method, score) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(avg_rank = mean(rank, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(score) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = method, names_from = score, 
              values_from = avg_rank, names_prefix = "Metric__")

# --- 3. MERGE, INVERT, AND SCALE (Fixes the Error) ---
final_data <- df_overall %>%
  left_join(df_datasets_wide, by = "method") %>%
  left_join(df_metrics_wide, by = "method") %>%
  # Add mandatory 'id' column for funkyheatmap
  mutate(id = method)

# Identify all rank-based columns
rank_cols <- c("Overall_Rank", colnames(final_data)[startsWith(colnames(final_data), "Dataset__")], 
               colnames(final_data)[startsWith(colnames(final_data), "Metric__")])

# Instead of using min(x) and max(x) which vary per column,
# we use the theoretical best (1) and worst (total methods).
num_methods <- length(unique(final_data$method))

scale_ranks_global <- function(x, n_meth) {
  if(all(is.na(x))) return(x)
  # BEST rank (1) should map to 1.0
  # WORST rank (n_meth) should map to 0.0
  # Formula: (Worst - Current) / (Worst - Best)
  (n_meth - x) / (n_meth - 1)
}

final_data <- final_data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(rank_cols), ~scale_ranks_global(.x, num_methods))) %>%
  arrange(desc(Overall_Rank))

# --- 4. COLUMN INFO CONFIGURATION ---
info_method <- tribble(
  ~id,      ~group, ~name,    ~geom, ~palette, ~options,
  "id",     "",     "",       "text", NA,       list(hjust = 0, width = 6)
)

info_overall <- tribble(
  ~id,            ~group,   ~name,      ~geom, ~palette,        ~options,
  "Overall_Rank", "Overall", "Avg Rank", "bar",  "palette_ranks", list(width = 4)
)

dataset_cols <- colnames(final_data)[startsWith(colnames(final_data), "Dataset__")]
info_datasets <- tibble(id = dataset_cols) %>%
  mutate(
    group = "Avg Rank per Dataset",
    name = str_remove(id, "Dataset__"), 
    geom = "circle",
    palette = "palette_ranks",
    options = list(list())
  )

metric_cols <- colnames(final_data)[startsWith(colnames(final_data), "Metric__")]
info_metrics <- tibble(id = metric_cols) %>%
  mutate(
    group = "Avg Rank per Metric",
    name = str_remove(id, "Metric__"),
    name_f = factor(name, levels = target_metric_order),
    geom = "bar",
    palette = "palette_ranks",
    options = list(list(width = 2))
  ) %>% 
  arrange(name_f) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-name_f)

column_info <- bind_rows(info_method, info_overall, info_datasets, info_metrics)

# --- 5. PLOT ---
ncolors <- 11
funky_heatmap(
  data = final_data,
  column_info = column_info,
  scale_column = FALSE, # Values are already 0-1
  palettes = list(
    palette_ranks = brewer.pal(n = ncolors, name = "RdBu")
  ),
  column_groups = tibble(
    group = c("Overall", "Avg Rank per Dataset", "Avg Rank per Metric")
  ),
  legends = list(
    list(palette = "palette_ranks", title = "Rank", labels = c(".       Worst", rep("", round((ncolors-2)/2)+1), "", rep("", round((ncolors-2)/2)), "Best    ."))
  )
)
ggsave(file.path(path_plots, "benchmark_summary_funkyheatmap_mainmethods_ranks.pdf"),
       width = 10,
       height = 5)
```

```{r}
pb2000_scores <- list()
pb_ct_hr_2000_scores <- list()
pb_ct_hr_500_scores <- list()

for (ds in names(result_list[["bmark"]])) {
  pb2000_scores[[ds]] <- result_list[["bmark"]][[ds]][["Pseudobulk_hvg2000"]]$scores
  pb_ct_hr_2000_scores[[ds]] <- result_list[["bmark"]][[ds]][["Pseudobulk_CT_HR_hvg2000"]]$scores
  pb_ct_hr_500_scores[[ds]] <- result_list[["bmark"]][[ds]][["Pseudobulk_CT_HR_hvg500"]]$scores
}


# Define a function to get the global average over the canonical benchmark
# metrics only. Alternate modularity neighborhoods are diagnostics-only.
get_global_avg <- function(score_list) {
  # 1. Calculate the mean for each dataset
  ds_means <- sapply(score_list, function(ds) {
    relevant_vals <- unlist(ds[names(ds) %in% benchmark_metrics])
    # Return the average of ANOSIM, Modularity [kNN3], and ARI.
    mean(relevant_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  
  # 2. Return the average of all dataset means
  return(mean(ds_means, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# Apply to your three result objects
avg_pb2000   <- get_global_avg(pb2000_scores)
avg_ct_2000 <- get_global_avg(pb_ct_hr_2000_scores)
avg_ct_500  <- get_global_avg(pb_ct_hr_500_scores)

cat("Pseudobulk_CT_HR_hvg2000 vs Pseudobulk_hvg2000: ", round(avg_ct_2000 / avg_pb2000, 2), "\n")
cat("Pseudobulk_CT_HR_hvg500 vs Pseudobulk_hvg2000: ", round(avg_ct_500 / avg_pb2000, 2))
```

```{r message=FALSE}
# --- 0. CLEAN DATA (self-contained: same filter/recode as Figure 2A, built

))

benchmark_method_recode <- c(
  "ECODA_authors_HR" = "ECODA",
  "ECODA_authors_HR_NULL" = "Shuffled_baseline",
  "Pseudobulk_hvg2000" = "Pseudobulk",
  "MOFA_hvg2000_factors15" = "MOFA",
  "scITD_hvg2000_factors5" = "scITD",
  "MrVI_hvg2000" = "MrVI",
  "scPoli_hvg2000_dims15_highres" = "scPoli",
  "PILOT_hvg2000" = "PILOT",
  "GloScope_hvg2000_pcadims30" = "GloScope",
  "QOT_hvg2000" = "QOT",
  "PILOT-GM-VAE_hvg2000" = "PILOT-GM-VAE"
)
clean_data <- prepare_benchmark_data(
  df_results = df_benchmark,
  exec_times = exec_times,
  filter_methods = filter_methods,
  method_recode = benchmark_method_recode,
  dataset_recode = dataset_display_map,

)

# --- 1. PREPARE WIDE DATA ---
metrics <- unname(score_label_map[base_metrics])
mean_score_components <- metrics

df_wide <- clean_data %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(dataset, method),
    names_from = score,
    values_from = value
  )
mean_score_data <- dplyr::select(df_wide, all_of(mean_score_components))
stopifnot(
  nrow(mean_score_data) > 0,
  all(complete.cases(mean_score_data))
)
df_wide$Mean_Score <- rowMeans(mean_score_data)

# --- 2. REUSABLE AXIS AND PLOTTING HELPERS ---
# Use each variable's observed range rather than one broad range for every
# metric. This keeps narrow metrics such as Silhouette from looking flat while
# retaining a 5% margin around every observed point.
metric_axis_range <- function(x, metric_name) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) {
    stop("Supp fig 1: no finite values available for ", metric_name)
  }

  observed <- range(x)
  span <- diff(observed)
  padding <- if (span > 0) 0.05 * span else max(0.05, 0.05 * abs(observed[1]))
  observed + c(-padding, padding)
}

metric_axis_breaks <- function(x, limits) {
  observed <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(observed) == 0) {
    stop("Supp fig 1: no finite values available for tick breaks")
  }

  breaks <- scales::breaks_extended(n = 4)(limits)

  # Keep a negative boundary tick visible when the observed data cross zero
  # but the extended-break algorithm starts at zero.
  if (min(observed) < 0 && min(breaks) >= 0) {
    negative_break <- floor(min(observed) / 0.1) * 0.1
    breaks <- sort(unique(c(negative_break, breaks)))
  }

  if (length(breaks) < 3L || length(breaks) > 5L) {
    stop("Supp fig 1: expected 3-5 meaningful ticks, got ", length(breaks))
  }
  breaks
}

build_metric_axis_spec <- function(data, variables) {
  metric_values <- setNames(
    lapply(variables, function(metric) data[[metric]]),
    variables
  )
  axis_ranges <- setNames(
    lapply(variables, function(metric) {
      metric_axis_range(metric_values[[metric]], metric)
    }),
    variables
  )
  axis_breaks <- Map(metric_axis_breaks, metric_values, axis_ranges)
  axis_ranges <- Map(
    function(lims, breaks) range(c(lims, breaks)),
    axis_ranges,
    axis_breaks
  )
  stopifnot(
    all(vapply(
      axis_breaks,
      function(breaks) length(breaks) >= 3L && length(breaks) <= 5L,
      logical(1)
    )),
    all(vapply(names(axis_ranges), function(metric) {
      values <- metric_values[[metric]]
      values <- values[is.finite(values)]
      all(
        values >= axis_ranges[[metric]][1] &
          values <= axis_ranges[[metric]][2]
      )
    }, logical(1)))
  )
  list(
    values = metric_values,
    ranges = axis_ranges,
    breaks = axis_breaks
  )
}

benchmark_axis_spec <- build_metric_axis_spec(
  df_wide,
  c("Mean_Score", metrics)
)
axis_ranges <- benchmark_axis_spec$ranges
axis_breaks <- benchmark_axis_spec$breaks
format_metric_ticks <- function(x) {
  x[abs(x) < 0.005] <- 0
  sprintf("%.2f", x)
}

# Add variable-specific meaningful 3-5 tick scales to each GGally panel. The
# coordinate limits are applied with coord_cartesian() so smoothing/statistical
# layers still see all rows; limits include every finite observation.
add_pairwise_axes <- function(plot, mapping, axis_spec, include_y = TRUE) {
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  plot <- plot +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = axis_spec$breaks[[x_name]],
      labels = format_metric_ticks,
      expand = c(0, 0)
    )

  if (include_y) {
    y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)
    plot <- plot +
      scale_y_continuous(
        breaks = axis_spec$breaks[[y_name]],
        labels = format_metric_ticks,
        expand = c(0, 0)
      ) +
      coord_cartesian(
        xlim = axis_spec$ranges[[x_name]],
        ylim = axis_spec$ranges[[y_name]],
        expand = FALSE
      )
  } else {
    plot <- plot +
      coord_cartesian(
        xlim = axis_spec$ranges[[x_name]],
        expand = FALSE
      )
  }

  plot
}

make_pairwise_upper <- function(digits = 2, text_size = 6.5) {
  function(data, mapping, ...) {
    ggally_cor(
      data,
      mapping,
      ...,
      stars = FALSE,
      digits = digits,
      title_args = list(size = text_size),
      group_args = list(size = text_size)
    )
  }
}

make_pairwise_lower <- function(axis_spec) {
  function(data, mapping, ...) {
    plot <- ggplot(data, mapping) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "#000000") +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", se = TRUE)
    add_pairwise_axes(plot, mapping, axis_spec)
  }
}

make_pairwise_diag <- function(axis_spec) {
  function(data, mapping, ...) {
    add_pairwise_axes(
      ggally_densityDiag(data, mapping, ...),
      mapping,
      axis_spec,
      include_y = FALSE
    )
  }
}

pairwise_upper <- make_pairwise_upper()
pairwise_lower <- make_pairwise_lower(benchmark_axis_spec)
pairwise_diag <- make_pairwise_diag(benchmark_axis_spec)

# --- 3. DYNAMICALLY GENERATE "METRIC VS MEAN" PLOTS ---
# purrr::map iterates over your metrics and creates a list of plots
plot_mean_corr <- function(data, metric_var, axis_spec) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Mean_Score, y = .data[[metric_var]])) +
    geom_abline(
      intercept = 0,
      slope = 1,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey50",
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "#000000", size = 1.5) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", linewidth = 1, se = FALSE) +
    stat_cor(
      aes(label = after_stat(rr.label)),
      label.x.npc = "right",
      label.y.npc = "bottom",
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 0,
      size = 5
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = metric_var) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = axis_spec$breaks[["Mean_Score"]],
      labels = format_metric_ticks,
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = axis_spec$breaks[[metric_var]],
      labels = format_metric_ticks,
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = axis_spec$ranges[["Mean_Score"]],
      ylim = axis_spec$ranges[[metric_var]],
      expand = FALSE
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
      aspect.ratio = 1
    )
}

mean_plots <- map(
  metrics,
  ~ plot_mean_corr(df_wide, .x, benchmark_axis_spec)
)

# Keep each mean-row panel square and separate adjacent axes so the repeated
# numeric tick labels do not collide. A single shared x-axis title replaces the
# five repeated "Mean Score" titles.
mean_row <- wrap_plots(mean_plots, nrow = 1) +
  theme(panel.spacing = grid::unit(1, "lines"))
mean_x_label <- wrap_elements(
  full = grid::textGrob(
    "Mean Score",
    x = grid::unit(0.5, "npc"),
    y = grid::unit(1, "npc"),
    just = c("center", "top"),
    gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 13)
  ),
  ignore_tag = TRUE
)
mean_row_with_label <- wrap_plots(
  list(mean_row, mean_x_label),
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(1, 0.08)
)
mean_panel <- wrap_elements(
  full = patchwork::patchworkGrob(mean_row_with_label),
  ignore_tag = TRUE
)
mean_panel_label <- wrap_elements(
  full = grid::textGrob(
    "B",
    x = grid::unit(0, "npc"),
    y = grid::unit(1, "npc"),
    just = c("left", "top"),
    gp = grid::gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 18)
  ),
  ignore_tag = TRUE
)
mean_panel_with_tag <- wrap_plots(
  list(mean_panel_label, mean_panel),
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(0.08, 1)
)

# --- 4. PAIRWISE CORRELATION MATRIX ---
# ggpairs returns a ggmatrix rather than a ggplot. Its public gtable converter
# lets patchwork compose it with the mean-row plot without changing the matrix.
pairwise_matrix <- ggpairs(
  df_wide,
  columns = metrics,
  upper = list(continuous = pairwise_upper),
  lower = list(continuous = pairwise_lower),
  diag = list(continuous = pairwise_diag)

  )

  ignore_tag = TRUE
)
pairwise_panel_label <- wrap_elements(
  full = grid::textGrob(
    "A",

)
pairwise_panel_with_tag <- wrap_plots(
  list(pairwise_panel_label, pairwise_panel),
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(0.02, 1)
)

# --- Supp fig X2A. MODULARITY-SCORE DIAGNOSTIC MATRIX ---
modularity_score_keys <- c(
  "mod_knn3_score",
  "mod_knn6_score",
  "mod_knn9_score",
  "mod_knnsqrtn_score"
)
modularity_metrics <- c(
  "Modularity kNN3",
  "Modularity kNN6",
  "Modularity kNN9",
  "Modularity sqrt(n)"
)
modularity_score_labels <- setNames(
  modularity_metrics,
  modularity_score_keys
)

df_modularity_long <- df_benchmark %>%
  filter(
    method %in% filter_methods,
    score %in% modularity_score_keys
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    dataset = recode(dataset, !!!dataset_display_map),
    method = recode(method, !!!benchmark_method_recode),
    modularity_metric = recode(score, !!!modularity_score_labels)
  ) %>%
  select(dataset, method, modularity_metric, value)
stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(df_modularity_long[c("dataset", "method", "modularity_metric")])
)

df_modularity_wide <- df_modularity_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(dataset, method),
    names_from = modularity_metric,
    values_from = value
  )
stopifnot(
  all(modularity_metrics %in% names(df_modularity_wide)),
  all(vapply(
    df_modularity_wide[modularity_metrics],
    function(x) all(is.finite(x)),
    logical(1)
  )),
  setequal(
    paste(df_modularity_wide$dataset, df_modularity_wide$method, sep = "\r"),
    paste(df_wide$dataset, df_wide$method, sep = "\r")
  )
)

modularity_axis_spec <- build_metric_axis_spec(
  df_modularity_wide,
  modularity_metrics
)
modularity_pairwise_matrix <- ggpairs(
  df_modularity_wide,
  columns = modularity_metrics,
  upper = list(continuous = make_pairwise_upper()),
  lower = list(
    continuous = make_pairwise_lower(modularity_axis_spec)
  ),
  diag = list(
    continuous = make_pairwise_diag(modularity_axis_spec)
  )
) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 9
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(1.5, "lines")
  )
modularity_pairwise_panel <- wrap_elements(
  full = GGally::ggmatrix_gtable(modularity_pairwise_matrix),
  ignore_tag = TRUE
)
modularity_pairwise_panel_label <- wrap_elements(
  full = grid::textGrob(
    "A",
    x = grid::unit(0, "npc"),
    y = grid::unit(1, "npc"),
    just = c("left", "top"),

  ),
  ignore_tag = TRUE
)
modularity_pairwise_panel_with_tag <- wrap_plots(

  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(0.02, 1)
)

# --- 4C. MODULARITY VARIANTS AGAINST THE SHARED MEAN SCORE ---
# Mean_Score is inherited from df_wide and is always:
# mean(ANOSIM, Modularity [kNN3], ARI, Silhouette, LISI).
df_modularity_vs_mean <- df_modularity_wide %>%
  inner_join(
    dplyr::select(df_wide, dataset, method, Mean_Score),
    by = c("dataset", "method")
  )
stopifnot(
  nrow(df_modularity_vs_mean) == nrow(df_modularity_wide),

modularity_mean_axis_spec <- build_metric_axis_spec(
  df_modularity_vs_mean,

)

modularity_mean_plots <- map(

) +

modularity_mean_row_with_label <- wrap_plots(

    y = grid::unit(1, "npc"),

  ),

modularity_mean_panel_with_tag <- wrap_plots(

  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(0.08, 1)
)

# --- Supp fig 1: COMBINE DEFAULT BENCHMARK PANELS ---
supp_fig_1 <- wrap_plots(
```

```{r}
# Per-dataset trans bundles are summarized data.frames without a dataset

df_normalization <- imap_dfr(result_list[["trans"]], ~ mutate(.x, dataset = .y)) %>%
  mutate(
    trans_method = recode(
      trans_method,
      "clr" = "CLR",

  ) %>%
```

# Supp fig 16 B: Plot zero imputation results

## Plot results

```{r}
zeroimp_result_list <- result_list[["zeroimp"]]
if (length(zeroimp_result_list) == 0) {
  stop("No zero-imputation results found (result_list$zeroimp is empty).",
       "\nRun the HPC zeroimp pipeline first (run_transformation_zeroimp_analysis/).")
}

df_zeroimp <- imap_dfr(zeroimp_result_list, ~ {
  dataset_name <- .y
  imap_dfr(.x, function(method_value, method_name) {
    if (is.list(method_value) && !is.data.frame(method_value)) {
      if (length(method_value) == 1 && is.list(method_value[[1]])) {
        method_value <- method_value[[1]]
      }
      if (!all(sapply(method_value, is.numeric))) {
        message(
          "Dropping non-numeric zeroimp rows for ", dataset_name, "/",
          method_name
        )
        return(tibble())
      }
    }
    imap_dfr(method_value, ~ tibble(
      dataset = dataset_name,
      method = method_name,
      score = .y,
      value = as.numeric(.x)
    ))
  })
})

    # aes(label = sprintf("%5.2f", as.numeric(..p.format..)))
  ) +
  ylim(c(-0.2, 1.2)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Separation score") +
  theme_classic2() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 65, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) +
  facet_grid(scales = "free",
             rows = vars(score),
             labeller = as_labeller(score_facet_labels))
```

# Supp fig X: ECODA author annotation sensitivity to cell depth

```{r fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
if (isTRUE(cell_subsetting_requested) && !is.null(cell_subsetting_results)) {
cell_subsetting_targets <- c(
  "all cells", "2000", "1000", "500", "400",
  "300", "200", "150", "100", "50"
)

cell_subsetting_dataset_means <- cell_subsetting_results$results %>%
  mutate(
    target = factor(target, levels = cell_subsetting_targets),
    dataset_display = if_else(
      dataset == "Gongsharma_cmv_young_males",
      "GongSharma",
      as.character(dataset)
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(dataset, dataset_display, target) %>%
  summarise(
    anosim = mean(anosim),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cell_subsetting_aggregate <- cell_subsetting_dataset_means %>%
  group_by(target) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_anosim = mean(anosim),
    se_anosim = sd(anosim) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_cell_subsetting <- ggplot() +
  geom_col(
    data = cell_subsetting_aggregate,
    aes(x = target, y = mean_anosim),
    fill = "white",
    color = "black",
    width = 0.72
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    data = cell_subsetting_aggregate,
    aes(
      x = target,
      ymin = mean_anosim - se_anosim,
      ymax = mean_anosim + se_anosim
    ),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = cell_subsetting_dataset_means,
    aes(
      x = target,
      y = anosim,
      group = dataset_display,
      color = dataset_display,
      linetype = dataset_display
    ),
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = cell_subsetting_dataset_means,
    aes(
      x = target,
      y = anosim,
      shape = dataset_display,
      color = dataset_display
    ),
    size = 2
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = cell_subsetting_targets,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Cells per sample",
    y = "Separation score (ANOSIM)",
    color = "Dataset",
    shape = "Dataset",
    linetype = "Dataset"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))

print(p_cell_subsetting)
ggsave(
  file.path(path_plots, "Supp_fig_X_ECODA_authors_HR_cell_subsetting.pdf"),
  width = 8,
  height = 5
)
}
```
